map.公摊面积 = 建筑面积 × 公摊系数；套内面积 = 建筑面积 − 公摊面积；物业: Shared area = gross floor area × shared coefficient; internal area = gross floor area − shared area; property fee = gross floor area × unit rate × months; whether shared cost is billed separately is controlled by the "shared-cost basis": when separate, shared cost = shared area × shared rate × months; when included in the property fee, it is 0; total payable = property fee + separately billed shared cost; monthly average = total ÷ months. Validation: gross floor area must be > 0; shared coefficient 0–100%; property/shared rates must not be blank or negative (0 is valid); custom months must be a positive integer; any invalid field stops the calculation and names the field. Billing assumptions: property fee is based on gross floor area; shared cost is either billed separately by shared area or treated as included. Late fees, discounts, vacancy reductions and taxes are not considered. Check the contract and published tariff to avoid double charging.
map.已含在物业费内（不另收）: Included in the property fee (not billed again)
map.已含在物业费内，不另收: Included in the property fee; not billed again
map.物业费 + 单列公摊费: Property fee + separately billed shared cost
map.计费假设：物业费按建筑面积计；公摊费按公摊面积单列，或视为已含在物业费内（不另收: Billing assumptions: the property fee is based on gross floor area; the shared cost is either billed separately by shared area or treated as included in the property fee (not billed again). This result excludes late fees, discounts, vacancy reductions and taxes, and does not determine the contract basis automatically. Check the property contract, published tariff or bill: if the contract charges by internal area or the shared cost is already included in the property fee, adjust accordingly to avoid double charging.
